title: Synthesis and Anticancer Evaluation of Disubstituted Benzimidazoles via One-Pot Telescopic Grinding Approach.
authors: Das, Soumyadip; Thansila, Parvin N; Maiti, Barnali; Padmaja, R D; Prathima, T S; Balamurali, M M; Chanda, Kaushik
one_liner_zh: 该文合成苯并咪唑衍生物并评估其抗癌活性，虽涉及核酸结合但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，AI仅用于活性预测而非结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Benzimidazole compounds are known for their broad spectrum therapeutic potentials. A small library of benzimidazole derivatives were designed and synthesized via a one-pot telescopic grinding approach. The ability of these molecules as proposed anticancer agents were evaluated by their potential to bind to two important cancer pathway protein targets, human estrogen receptors and cyclin dependant kinases, 3ERT and 5FGK respectively. Further nucleic acid binding and reactive oxygen species (ROS) scavenging capacity being in the scope for anticancer potential evaluations, the ability of these molecules have been evaluated for the same. Further, to support the experimental and computational results, AI-assisted tools were employed to predict the anticancer activity (PASS) as well as to identify false positives (PAINS). Also, the druggability of the proposed compounds was evaluated by following their pharmacokinetic parameters - ADME.
abstract_zh: 苯并咪唑类化合物以其广谱治疗潜力而闻名。通过一锅串联研磨方法设计并合成了一小组苯并咪唑衍生物。这些分子作为拟议抗癌剂的潜力通过其与两个重要癌症通路蛋白靶点——人雌激素受体和细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶（分别为3ERT和5FGK）结合的能力进行评估。此外，核酸结合和活性氧（ROS）清除能力在抗癌潜力评估范围内，这些分子的相应能力也已被评估。进一步地，为支持实验和计算结果，采用了AI辅助工具来预测抗癌活性（PASS）以及识别假阳性（PAINS）。同时，通过遵循其药代动力学参数——ADME，评估了拟议化合物的成药性。
